description: This Java class implements an Android activity that demonstrates a 3D flip transition between a ListView of photos and an ImageView showing a selected photo. It uses custom 3D rotation animations to achieve the flip effect, handling user interactions and view swapping with animation listeners.

classes.name: Transition3d
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the 3D flip transition between a list of photos and a detailed view of a selected photo. Implements user interaction handlers and orchestrates animation sequences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, adapters, and event listeners.

methods.name: applyRotation
methods.description: Configures and starts a 3D rotation animation to flip between views.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by loading the selected photo and starting the flip animation.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on the ImageView to flip back to the list.
